question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Moral degradation is responsible for social degeneration. We should develop morality if we want to establish peace, order and justice. Morality is something that can helps in making our society crime-free. The lack of moral values encourages a man to commit crimes and social evils. Therefore, it is the duty of all men to develop morality in themselves and reform good work for the welfare of mankind. অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : ইন্টারপোল হচ্ছেInternational Criminal Police Organization, এর উৎপত্তি হয়েছে International এবং Police শব্দ দুটি থেকে। এটা International 139 I was on receipt of your letter yesterday. I am happy to learn that you are well. I am well too. You wrote to me that you are weak in English. I am not at home in English as well. However, as a friend, I must tell you what I have recently learnt regarding it. Learning English is not something to memorise, rather it is something to acquire through constant practice. First, read English quite a lot. This will help you increase your stock of vocabulary. Remember, you may not understand all the words. But try to guess their meaning from the context . If you can't, you look them up in the dictionary. This will certainly increase your vocabulary. Then I would like to suggest you to be interested in grammatical rules. This will help you know how sentences are made. Next, you should attend English classes regularly. In the class, you should speak English with your friends. If possible, attend special coaching for learning English. Try to use English in speaking and writing in a practical way. In this way, I think, you will be able to improve English gradually. Wish you all the best. Yours ever, Sami
